_FIELD_TEST_ONLY: BRANCH feat/hello-pok-fieldtest -- DO NOT MERGE TO main-0.7.
The 'holochain' and 'hc' entries for x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu below are NOT the
stock holochain 0.7.0 release artifacts. They are checksums of locally built,
PATCHED binaries from lightningrodlabs/holochain branch feat/hello-pok-access-0.7,
which carry the kitsune2 hello/PoK access module. There is no GitHub release to
download them from -- they must be placed on disk with `yarn install:local-binaries`
These are cargo-zigbuild builds pinned to a GLIBC 2.34 baseline, matching the
envelope of the stock holochain releases. A plain `cargo build --release` inherits
the build machine's glibc and will not start on older distros -- never distribute one.
EVERY OTHER PLATFORM ENTRY IN THIS FILE STILL REFERENCES STOCK HOLOCHAIN 0.7.0.
A field test cohort built from this branch is therefore LINUX x86_64 ONLY: patched
nodes advertise HCP2P_PROTO_VER=1002 and refuse stock peers at preflight, so a mixed
cohort would split-brain silently. macOS/Windows testers cannot join until those
targets are built from feat/hello-pok-access-0.7 and their checksums added here.
NOTE: `yarn update-hc-checksums` regenerates this file from GitHub release assets
and will destroy both this note and the patched checksums.
